import ast,json,runpy
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("reports/T0009/review-r2-counts")
counts=runpy.run_path("reports/T0009/review-r1/probe.py")["scan_counts"]()
assert all(x["conclusion_reads_after_T0008"] <= x["regression_upper_bound"] for x in counts)
tree=ast.parse(Path("src/kmesh/logic/proof_enumeration.py").read_text())
recursive=[f.name for f in tree.body if isinstance(f,ast.FunctionDef) and any(isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id==f.name for n in ast.walk(f))]
assert not recursive
import kmesh.logic.proof_enumeration as pe
from kmesh.logic.derivations import GroundDerivation
from kmesh.logic.types import Atom,Clause
from kmesh.logic.proof import verify_proof
n=64
clauses=(Clause((),Atom("k0",("a","b"))),)+tuple(Clause((Atom(f"k{j-1}",("?x","?y")),),Atom(f"k{j}",("?x","?y"))) for j in range(1,n+1))
original=GroundDerivation.__getattribute__; original_enum=pe.enumerate_derivations
stats={"active":False,"reads":0}
def counted(self,name):
 if stats["active"] and name=="conclusion":stats["reads"]+=1
 return original(self,name)
def enum(*args,**kwargs):
 result=original_enum(*args,**kwargs);stats["active"]=True;return result
try:
 GroundDerivation.__getattribute__=counted;pe.enumerate_derivations=enum
 proofs=pe.enumerate_proofs(clauses,Atom("k64",("a","b")),max_fact_checks=64,max_derivations=65,max_proof_steps=2145)
finally:
 stats["active"]=False;GroundDerivation.__getattribute__=original;pe.enumerate_derivations=original_enum
assert len(proofs)==1 and len(proofs[0])==65 and verify_proof(clauses,Atom("k64",("a","b")),proofs[0])
result={"result":"PASS","S_1_counts":counts,"recursive_helpers":recursive,"full_expansion_S_2145_reads":stats["reads"],"interpretation":"S=1 probe uses 69 reads at 65 records; 260 reproduced under S=2145 full expansion, a different measurement scope. Pi unrecorded probe history remains unknown."}
(p/"findings.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
